queries: WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rental_count FROM film AS f LEFT JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id LEFT JOIN rental AS r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id GROUP BY f.rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rental_count) AS avg_count FROM rating_counts) SELECT AVG(rc.rental_count) AS average_rental_count, AVG(rc.rental_count - o.avg_count) AS average_excess FROM rating_counts AS rc CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE rc.rental_count > o.avg_count

WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS rental_count FROM rental AS r JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rental_count) AS avg_count FROM rating_counts) SELECT AVG(rc.rental_count) AS avg_count_above_average, AVG(rc.rental_count - o.avg_count) AS avg_excess FROM rating_counts AS rc CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE rc.rental_count > o.avg_count
